newsitem.title: GERMANY: German mayor candidate cuts off rivals with axe.
newsitem.headline: German mayor candidate cuts off rivals with axe.

text.p: A television debate among five leading candidates for mayor of Stuttgart was abruptly ended on Thursday night when an uninvited candidate destroyed the main broadcast cable with an axe, police said.

Because he was not considered a serious candidate, Udo Bausch was excluded from the debate broadcast on regional television. Shortly after the live broadcast began, Bausch, 36, cut the cable with an axe.
Bausch, immediately detained by police, was not the only candidate excluded. Konrad Kujau, who gained world fame for his forged Hitler diaries, is also running.
